name: Mickey's Smokestack BBQ Slow-Smoked Pulled Pork Shoulder (Standalone)
whyItWorks: Shredded slow-smoked pork shoulder is ultra-tender and zero-fiber when ordered un-sauced on a white brioche bun.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for plain pulled pork before BBQ sauce is ladled on, paired with Baked Mac & Cheese or a white bun.
watchOuts: Higher rendered pork shoulder fat than smoked chicken
